subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is **NOT** correct?

options.text: The Swaran Singh Committee recommended that the duty to pay taxes should also be a fundamental duty of the Citizen.
The original Constitution in 1950 did not incorporate any chapter on fundamental duties.
The fundamental duties are justiciable in a court of law.
In the Kathiawad political conference of 1925, Gandhiji remarked that the true source of right is duty.

solution:
The Correct Answer is **The fundamental duties are justiciable in a court of law.** 

These duties are **non-justiciable** i.e. any violation is **not punishable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original Constitution in 1950 did not incorporate any chapter on fundamental duties.
 
• Fundamental duties were added to the Constitution by the 42nd Amendment (1976) of the Constitution for the citizens of India.
